bio.text: Jenny Rae Le Roux is the Republican candidate for California's 47th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Le Roux was born in Memphis, Tennessee, and earned a B.A. in economics from the University of Virginia in 2002 and an M.B.A. from Columbia University Business School in 2018.
Le Roux's career experience includes owning a business, working as managing director of Management Consulted, and writing as an author and strategic advisor.
